identity.name: Constellation
identity.one_liner: The 39mm Globemaster with the fluted bezel and the Master Chronometer caliber 8800 — the first Master Chronometer in the Omega catalogue, the watch that defined Omega's 2015+ certification standard.

narrative.story: The Globemaster (131.10.39.20.06.001) is the 2015 reference that introduced the Master Chronometer certification to the Omega catalogue. The Master Chronometer is a METAS certification that tests the watch to 15,000 gauss of magnetic resistance (most watches tolerate 60-100 gauss), accuracy of 0/+5 seconds per day, and water resistance. The 8800 caliber is a co-axial automatic. The fluted bezel is the Constellation family's signature. The Globemaster is the most-cited modern Omega in the $5,000-7,000 price band and the watch a collector cites when arguing Omega's in-house calibers are now competitive with the Swiss haute horlogerie standard.
